title: Homomorphic Cache Guard
rationale: Current in‑memory data structures are vulnerable to memory‑scraping attacks and side‑channel leakage. By storing values in a reversible homomorphic‑encrypted form and adding automatic expiration, Cortana hardens its operational cache against adversarial inspection while preserving the ability to compute on encrypted data in the future. This upgrade expands the security frontier from network‑level protections to runtime data confidentiality, directly supporting the operator’s need for resilient, tamper‑evident state during high‑risk missions.
next_hypothesis: Future work will replace the XOR placeholder with a lattice‑based fully homomorphic encryption scheme, enabling secure multi‑party computation over cached data while preserving zero‑knowledge integrity checks.
